description: K₃NaS₂ crystallizes in the hexagonal P̅6m2 space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are three shorter (3.46 Å) and three longer (3.48 Å) K-S bond lengths. In the second K site, K is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to five S atoms. There are three shorter (2.94 Å) and two longer (3.69 Å) K-S bond lengths. Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent S atoms. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.94 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 11-coordinate geometry to eight K and three equivalent Na atoms. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine K atoms.
